description: This file is a shell script used to run a series of tests for Git filters, including setup, conversion checks, and validation of large file handling.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.description: Sets git attributes for the test environment, especially eol, ident, and custom filter attributes.

methods.name: check_input
methods.description: Checks the input conversion filters by comparing the states of small and large files processed via git read-tree and cat-file.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Checks the output conversion filters by verifying large files after checkout match expected patterns.
